questions.question: Identify the segment which contains a grammatical error. 'Each of the students have submitted their assignment.'
questions.explanation: 'Each' is a singular subject, so the verb should be singular 'has' instead of 'have'. Correct: 'Each of the students has...'

hi.question: दिए गए वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है? 'Each of the students have submitted their assignment.'
hi.explanation: 'Each' एक singular subject है, इसलिए इसके साथ verb भी singular (has) होनी चाहिए।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: ABANDON
questions.explanation: Abandon means to leave or forsake. 'Leave' is the correct synonym.

hi.question: दिए गए शब्द का सही पर्यायवाची (Synonym) चुनें: ABANDON
hi.explanation: Abandon का अर्थ है त्यागना या छोड़ना। Leave का अर्थ भी यही है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: My mother is _____ honest woman.
questions.explanation: The word 'honest' starts with a vowel sound ('o'), so the article 'an' is used.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: My mother is _____ honest woman.
hi.explanation: 'Honest' का उच्चारण स्वर (Vowel sound - ओ) से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'an' का प्रयोग होगा।

questions.question: Select the meaning of the idiom: 'Once in a blue moon'
questions.explanation: 'Once in a blue moon' means something that happens very rarely.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ चुनें: 'Once in a blue moon'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'बहुत ही दुर्लभ' या 'कभी-कभार'।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: TRANSPARENT
questions.explanation: Transparent means allowing light to pass through. Opaque means not allowing light to pass through.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: TRANSPARENT
hi.explanation: Transparent (पारदर्शी) का उल्टा Opaque (अपारदर्शी) होता है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'A place where birds are kept'
questions.explanation: An Aviary is a place for keeping birds. Apiary is for bees.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'A place where birds are kept'
hi.explanation: पक्षियों को रखने की जगह को Aviary कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Accommodation' (double c, double m).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Accommodation' है (दो c, दो m)।

questions.question: Improve the underlined part: No sooner did I reach the station *then* the train left.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner' is always followed by 'than'.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: No sooner did I reach the station *then* the train left.
hi.explanation: 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'then' का नहीं।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'The scenery of Kashmir are very beautiful.'
questions.explanation: 'Scenery' is an uncountable noun and is always singular. It should be 'is very'.

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'The scenery of Kashmir are very beautiful.'
hi.explanation: 'Scenery' uncountable noun है, इसलिए इसके साथ singular verb 'is' का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She died _____ cancer.
questions.explanation: We use 'died of' when referring to a disease.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: She died _____ cancer.
hi.explanation: बीमारी से मृत्यु होने पर 'died of' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: ALERT
questions.explanation: Alert means quick to notice potential danger; watchful.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: ALERT
hi.explanation: Alert का अर्थ है सतर्क। Watchful का अर्थ भी सतर्क होता है।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'At the eleventh hour'
questions.explanation: 'At the eleventh hour' means at the latest possible time.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'At the eleventh hour'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'बिल्कुल अंतिम समय पर'।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Business'.

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Business' है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'One who cannot read or write'
questions.explanation: Illiterate is a person who is unable to read or write.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'One who cannot read or write'
hi.explanation: जो पढ़-लिख न सके उसे Illiterate (निरक्षर) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: I prefer coffee *than* tea.
questions.explanation: The word 'prefer' is followed by 'to', not 'than'.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: I prefer coffee *than* tea.
hi.explanation: 'Prefer' के साथ हमेशा 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The train departed _____ time.
questions.explanation: 'On time' means at the planned time. 'In time' means before the deadline.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The train departed _____ time.
hi.explanation: निर्धारित समय पर के लिए 'on time' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: ANCIENT
questions.explanation: Ancient means very old. Modern means current or recent.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: ANCIENT
hi.explanation: Ancient (प्राचीन) का विलोम Modern (आधुनिक) है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I have been waiting for you _____ two hours.
questions.explanation: 'For' is used for a duration of time (two hours). 'Since' is used for a point of time.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: I have been waiting for you _____ two hours.
hi.explanation: समय की अवधि (Duration) के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'Unless you do not work hard, you will fail.'
questions.explanation: 'Unless' is a negative condition, so we do not use 'do not' with it. Correct: 'Unless you work hard...'

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'Unless you do not work hard, you will fail.'
hi.explanation: 'Unless' स्वयं एक नकारात्मक शब्द है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'do not' का प्रयोग नहीं होता।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Occurrence' (double c, double r, ence).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Occurrence' है।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'Apple of one's eye'
questions.explanation: It means someone who is cherished above all others.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'Apple of one's eye'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'आंखों का तारा' या 'बहुत प्यारा'।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: My sister is *more cleverer* than me.
questions.explanation: Double comparatives (more cleverer) are incorrect. 'Cleverer' is the correct comparative form.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: My sister is *more cleverer* than me.
hi.explanation: दो बार comparative (more cleverer) का प्रयोग गलत है। सही शब्द 'cleverer' है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'Life history of a person written by himself'
questions.explanation: Autobiography is a self-written life history. Biography is written by someone else.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'Life history of a person written by himself'
hi.explanation: खुद के द्वारा लिखी गई जीवनी को Autobiography (आत्मकथा) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: ASSIST
questions.explanation: Assist means to help.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: ASSIST
hi.explanation: Assist का अर्थ है मदद करना (Help)।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Don't give _____ so easily.
questions.explanation: 'Give up' means to stop making an effort or surrender.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: Don't give _____ so easily.
hi.explanation: 'Give up' का अर्थ है हार मान लेना। वाक्य: इतनी आसानी से हार मत मानो।
